functions.name: sub_28B870
functions.why: reported as an indirect branch target with the same call context as 00361260. Sits inside the mapped function 0028B800, whose reference counterpart has different bounds; the target's own entry is missing from the table.

functions.name: sub_28B890
functions.why: same as 0028B870: a second entry inside mapped function 0028B800 that the table does not have.

functions.name: sub_361260
functions.why: reported as an indirect branch 285 times; the caller is target 0035F748 (reference 0035F408), which does 'lw r2, gp+0xDAC8' then 'jalr r2', so the address comes from a data pointer and is in no call instruction. The reference twin is a frame prologue with the same ten-instruction opening; the map instead places it on 003611A4.
